history.summary: IDENTITY UNVERIFIED: Yamunanagar has several Shani shrines (Ravi Nagar Road, Jagadhri, HUDA, Chitta Mandir Road). The most travel-listed one (MakeMyTrip) is the Shani Mandir dedicated to Shani Bhagawan about 2 km from the Jagadhri Workshop railway station, known for intricate architecture and heavy Tuesday/Saturday evening footfall. This file is documented against the Shani Mandir on Chitta Mandir Road (approx 30.12435, 77.30934), which adjoins the listed Prachin Shani Mandir; the intended CSV referent could not be pinned down. Coordinates approximate; founding date unknown.

name: Shani Mandir
town_description: Yamunanagar is a city in Haryana's Yamunanagar district on the western bank of the Yamuna river, a twin-city with Jagadhri known for its plywood and paper industries and railway workshop. It grew around the colonial-era town of Abdullahpur and today serves as the district headquarters, with pilgrimage spots such as the Chitta Mandir and Kapal Mochan tirtha nearby.

travel.railway: Jagadhri Workshop railway station, approx 2 km from the travel-listed Shani Mandir (verify)
travel.road: Chitta Mandir Road area, Yamunanagar; local auto/taxi (verify)
